## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<script>
(() => {
  const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');
  const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
  const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
  const photoPreview = document.getElementById('photoPreview');
  const changePhoto = document.getElementById('changePhoto');
  const fileLabel = document.getElementById('fileLabel');
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('promptInput');
  const charCount = document.getElementById('charCount');
  const consentCheck = document.getElementById('consentCheck');
  const prepareBtn = document.getElementById('prepareBtn');
  const buttonHint = document.getElementById('buttonHint');
  const resultPanel = document.getElementById('resultPanel');
  const briefText = document.getElementById('briefText');
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  let selectedFile = null;
  let previewUrl = null;
  let currentBrief = '';
  let toastTimer;

  function showToast(message) {
    toast.textContent = message;
    toast.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
  }

  function refreshForm() {
    charCount.textContent = promptInput.value.length;
    prepareBtn.disabled = !(selectedFile && promptInput.value.trim() && consentCheck.checked);
    if (!selectedFile) buttonHint.textContent = 'Add a photo, describe your edit, and confirm permission to continue.';
    else if (!promptInput.value.trim()) buttonHint.textContent = 'Describe the change you would like to make.';
    else if (!consentCheck.checked) buttonHint.textContent = 'Confirm the person is an adult and you have permission to edit the photo.';
    else buttonHint.textContent = 'Your photo stays on this device. A text brief will be prepared below.';
  }

  function openPicker() {
    fileInput.click();
  }

  function useFile(file) {
    if (!file) return;
    const supportedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
    if (!supportedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showToast('Choose a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image.');
      fileInput.value = '';
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showToast('That image is larger than 15 MB. Choose a smaller file.');
      fileInput.value = '';
      return;
    }
    if (previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
    selectedFile = file;
    previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    photoPreview.src = previewUrl;
    photoPreview.hidden = false;
    emptyState.hidden = true;
    changePhoto.hidden = false;
    fileLabel.textContent = file.name;
    resultPanel.hidden = true;
    refreshForm();
  }

  dropZone.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.target.closest('.change-photo')) return;
    openPicker();
  });
  dropZone.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.target === dropZone && (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      openPicker();
    }
  });
  changePhoto.addEventListener('click', event => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    openPicker();
  });
  fileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
    if (fileInput.files.length) useFile(fileInput.files[0]);
  });
  ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(type => dropZone.addEventListener(type, event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    dropZone.classList.add('dragging');
  }));
  ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(type => dropZone.addEventListener(type, event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    dropZone.classList.remove('dragging');
  }));
  dropZone.addEventListener('drop', event => {
    const file = event.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file) useFile(file);
  });

  promptInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    resultPanel.hidden = true;
    refreshForm();
  });
  consentCheck.addEventListener('change', refreshForm);
  document.getElementById('examples').addEventListener('click', event => {
    const example = event.target.closest('[data-prompt]');
    if (!example) return;
    promptInput.value = example.dataset.prompt;
    promptInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    promptInput.focus();
  });

  prepareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (prepareBtn.disabled || !selectedFile) return;
    currentBrief = `IMAGE EDITING BRIEF\n\nSelected image: ${selectedFile.name}\n\nRequested edit:\n${promptInput.value.trim()}\n\nPreserve the subject's identity and any details not specifically requested to change. Use only with the depicted adult's permission.`;
    briefText.textContent = currentBrief;
    resultPanel.hidden = false;
    resultPanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
  });

  document.getElementById('copyBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (!currentBrief) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentBrief);
      showToast('Brief copied to clipboard.');
    } catch (error) {
      const selection = window.getSelection();
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(briefText);
      selection.removeAllRanges();
      selection.addRange(range);
      showToast('Select the highlighted brief and copy it.');
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('downloadBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!currentBrief) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([currentBrief], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' }));
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = 'muse-edit-brief.txt';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showToast('Brief downloaded.');
  });

  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    if (previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
  });
  refreshForm();
})();

content.text:
1. Create an API key in your OpenAI Platform account, and make sure API billing is enabled.
2. In a terminal, go to the project folder and enter:

   ```bash
   read -s -p "OpenAI API key: " OPENAI_API_KEY
   echo
   export OPENAI_API_KEY
   ./start.sh
   ```

   The key won’t appear as you type. If the app is already running in that terminal, stop it with **Ctrl+C** first, then restart it.
